experiment_data.hypothesis: Official SmolVLA LIBERO checkpoint with k=0.5 random pruning (keep 50% = 64/128 tokens) on LIBERO-Object. If 0% SR (same as our fine-tuned model), confirms cliff-edge is inherent to pixel-shuffle architecture, not fine-tuning-specific. If >0%, suggests official training creates different token dependencies.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress && MUJOCO_GL=egl PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python -u eval_official_libero.py --pretrained_dir /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/smolvla_libero_official --suite libero_object --num_episodes 50 --gpu 0 --mode random_prune --k_ratio 0.5 --seed 42 --output eval_results/official_libero_object_random_prune_k05.json 2>&1 | tee eval_results/eval_official_smolvla_prune_k05.log"
